A EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030;A Circular Economy Action Plan;+;2;The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 aims to protect and restore biodiversity, which can reinforce the Circular Economy Action Plan by promoting sustainable consumption and production patterns, reducing waste, and increasing recycling rates.
A EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030;A Farm to Fork Strategy;+;2;The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 can aid the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable agriculture practices, reducing pesticide use, and increasing organic farming, which can lead to more sustainable food systems.
A Circular Economy Action Plan;A EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030;+;2;The Circular Economy Action Plan can support the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 by reducing waste, increasing recycling rates, and promoting sustainable consumption patterns, which can help protect and restore biodiversity.

A EU Soil Strategy for 2030;A Circular Economy Action Plan;+;1;The EU Soil Strategy for 2030 can enable the Circular Economy Action Plan by promoting sustainable soil management practices, reducing soil pollution, and increasing soil health, which can lead to more sustainable ecosystems.

A Nature Restoration Law;A Circular Economy Action Plan;+;1;The Nature Restoration Law can enable the Circular Economy Action Plan by promoting ecosystem restoration, reducing pollution, and increasing biodiversity, which can lead to more sustainable ecosystems.
A Nature Restoration Law;A Farm to Fork Strategy;+;1;The Nature Restoration Law can support the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable agriculture practices, reducing pollution, and increasing biodiversity, which can lead to more sustainable food systems.
A EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030;A Nature Restoration Law;+;3;The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 and the Nature Restoration Law are indivisibly linked, as the strategy aims to protect and restore biodiversity, and the law provides a framework for nature restoration, which can lead to significant positive impacts on biodiversity.
